name: Valley Fabrication, Inc.
old_description: Serving North Central Illinois since 1973.  Our experience in Industrial Fabrication is unmatched.
about:
Valley Fabrication, Inc. was founded in 1973 in La Salle, Illinois. The company operates as a sister concern to Machinery Maintenance, Inc. and On Site Repair Services, Inc., serving Central Illinois from its La Salle base.

The shop provides full-service metal fabrication, including custom weldments, tank and structural steel fabrication, transition and ductwork pieces, stairs, platforms, and conveyor replacement parts. Its welding capabilities cover MIG, TIG, submerged arc, and exotic alloy welding (aluminum, stainless steel, Monel), with steel cutting up to 6 inches and plasma cutting up to 2 inches. The facility encompasses over 120,000 square feet of workable space, including a 40,000-square-foot fabrication area equipped for large, complex projects. An in-house American Welding Society (AWS) certified training facility runs an apprenticeship program led by a certified instructor.

Valley Fabrication primarily serves industrial maintenance and heavy-equipment sectors in North Central Illinois, repairing buckets, cutting edges, bores, shafts, and wear surfaces for loaders, excavators, dozers, and shovels, as well as screw conveyor flighting, crushers, screeners, and shakers. Its customer base spans cities such as LaSalle, Peru, Ottawa, Spring Valley, Rockford, and Bloomington.

The company emphasizes an AWS-certified workforce, ongoing OSHA safety training, and a mission to deliver the highest value materials and services in the most timely manner. Its apprenticeship program and certified weld inspections are cited as key differentiators.
